sources.title: Miracle of Marcelino — Restored 1955 Version
claims: Distributor explicitly distinguishes Spanish soundtrack from English dubbing; supports Spanish as original-language filter, not English.

sources.title: The Trial of Joan of Arc (Blu-ray)
claims: 1962 Robert Bresson title; language French, English subtitles. BFI edition runs 64 minutes; duration not asserted across editions.

sources.title: Cielo sulla palude
claims: Library catalogue identifies the Genina film's DVD as Italian-language.

sources.title: Cielo sulla palude — DVD
sources.publisher: Webster / 20th Century Fox Home Entertainment product record
claims: 1949 Genina film; 2010 Italian DVD edition has Italian audio and Italian hard-of-hearing subtitles; corroborates language, not universal runtime.

sources.title: Angels of Sin / Les anges du péché
sources.publisher: Film at Lincoln Center / 54th New York Film Festival
claims: Festival's 1943 Robert Bresson screening lists French with English subtitles; original title Les anges du péché. Its 96-minute screening runtime is not applied to every edition.

sources.title: La Guerra de Dios [DVD] (1953)
sources.publisher: DVD Store Spain / Karma Films product record
claims: Rafael Gil 1953 film; product record explicitly identifies original language as Spanish, alongside Castellano audio.

sources.title: Come to the Stable
claims: 1949 Henry Koster film; original language explicitly English. This establishes principal original language, not an exhaustive inventory of incidental speech.

sources.title: Into Great Silence
claims: Distributor explicitly lists original languages French/Latin with English subtitles, 2005 Philip Groning documentary.

sources.title: Teresa de Jesús
claims: Original broadcaster uses title Teresa de Jesús for the 1984 series.

sources.title: No Greater Love (2009)
claims: British film catalogue identifies the 2009 UK Michael Whyte production under No Greater Love; title is not an English translation of a foreign original.

sources.title: All That Remains
claims: UK 2016 English-language Ian and Dominic Higgins production identified as All That Remains.
